text: No tree-cover loss occurred on this asset after 2020. The analysis used annual data from 2001 to 2025, with the latest observation in 2025. The JRC 2020 reference confirmed 43.3 hectares of forest cover in 2020, and no subsequent loss events were detected. The minimum detectable event area was 0.5 hectares, ensuring even small changes would be identified. The full asset area was covered by valid data, with no gaps. Thus, the asset retained its tree cover beyond 2020.
